app.title: Smriti Saathi
app.subtitle: AI Elderly Guardian & Cognitive Companion
app.tagline: Dementia assistance and cognitive practice for North East India

disclaimer.legal: This app supports memory practice and safety. It does not diagnose or treat dementia or any medical condition. Please consult a doctor for health concerns.

auth.mobile_desc: We will send a 6-digit verification code to your phone
auth.demo_banner: DEMO MODE: No SMS is sent. Your verification code is {{code}}

onboarding.who_are_you: Who is setting up this app?
onboarding.voice_sample_text: Namaste. I am your Smriti Saathi companion. I will speak slowly and clearly.

home.helper_hint: Caregivers: Press and hold app title for 3 seconds for Settings

voice.not_installed: Spoken voice for this language is not installed on your device.
voice.install_guide: On Android: Go to Settings > System > Accessibility > Text-to-speech output, tap the settings gear and install language data.

location.permission_explanation: We use your location only to guide you home and to tell your family where you are. You can turn it off anytime.
location.denied_android: In Chrome: Tap the lock icon in the address bar > Permissions > Location > Allow.
location.denied_ios: In Safari: Tap 'AA' in the search bar > Website Settings > Location > Allow.
location.position_unavailable: GPS signal unavailable. Please move near a window or outdoors.
location.timeout: Location request timed out. Please try again.

games.title: Brain Practice Games
games.whose_voice_desc: Listen to voices and pick who is speaking
games.routine_recall_desc: Put your daily activities in the right order
games.voice_fluency_desc: Speak out as many category items as you can
games.fluency_prompt: Name as many {{category}} as you can in 1 minute!
games.fluency_helper_fallback: Helper: Tap words spoken if speech recognition is unavailable
games.lets_rest: You have practiced wonderfully today! Let's take a calm rest.
games.encouragement: Wonderful practice! Every step keeps memory active and joyful.
games.hint: Here is a gentle hint for you
games.mood_checkin: How are you feeling right now?

reminders.title: Daily Reminders
reminders.family_alerted: Caregiver has been notified that medicine was not confirmed.

safety.sos_hold: Hold button for 1.5 seconds or double tap to call family
safety.call_acknowledged: Your family has answered! Help is on the way.
safety.call_fallback: Please call your family directly or tap 112:
safety.where_to_go: Where do you want to go?

silent_guardian.checkin_prompt: You are away from your usual places. Do you want to go home?

easyride.title: Book a Ride
easyride.no_drivers: No drivers saved yet. Add local auto and taxi drivers in Setup.

diagnostics.title: System Diagnostics
diagnostics.subtitle: Real-time health of services, database, voice, and sensors
diagnostics.no_errors: No server errors recorded. System running smoothly.

errors.SERVER_ERROR: Internal server error. Please try again.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Session expired. Please log in with your mobile number.
errors.INVALID_PHONE: Please enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.
errors.INVALID_CODE: Incorrect verification code. Please check and re-enter.
errors.OTP_EXPIRED: Verification code has expired. Please request a new code.
errors.OTP_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Code locked for safety.
errors.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Too many requests. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.RESEND_WAIT: Please wait before requesting another code.
errors.PROVIDER_ERROR: SMS provider error. Please use demo mode or verify your number.
errors.NAME_REQUIRED: Elder's name is required to continue.
